objective: Auditar en modo READ_ONLY el fix quirurgico de scope para Cavas. Determinar si CavaSocios_Socios.EmpresaID debe resolverse con UnidadNegocioID UUID del contexto autorizado en vez de Usuario_RolesContexto.EmpresaID, sin cambiar RBAC global ni datos. Confirmar alcance minimo de cambio dentro de cava_socios y compatibilidad con tablas relacionadas. No implementar.

queries.name: scope_column_types
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos')) AND c.name=N'EmpresaID' ORDER BY table_name;

queries.name: scope_candidate_context
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),urc.UnidadNegocioID) AS UnidadNegocioID,urc.EmpresaID,un.codigo,un.nombre FROM dbo.Usuario_RolesContexto urc INNER JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio un ON un.id=urc.UnidadNegocioID WHERE urc.UsuarioID=4 AND urc.UnidadNegocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C') AND urc.Activo=1;

queries.name: scope_socios_vs_unidad
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,SUM(CASE WHEN un.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_unidad,SUM(CASE WHEN un.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_match_unidad FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios s LEFT JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio un ON un.id=s.EmpresaID;

constraints: No changes to RBAC global behavior
No permission role user menu unit or company changes
Prefer a module-local surgical fix if evidence supports it
EDARSAHUB SQL Server remains source of truth
